whoWeAre.heading: Who We Are
whoWeAre.subtitle: Four friends. One passion. A mission to change the way young people experience wine.
whoWeAre.storyPara1: Four students at ESCP, brought together not just by lectures and case studies, but by a shared obsession with wine. We spent weekends visiting cellars in Bordeaux and Burgundy, arguing about tannins over cheap bistro tables, and slowly realising something: wine had an image problem. It felt exclusive, complicated, reserved for people who already knew.
whoWeAre.storyPara2: We wanted to change that. Vivo Wine Club was born from a simple idea — bring great wine to great people, without the pretension. Themed parties, intimate winery visits, curated tastings. No dress codes. No gatekeeping. Just bottles worth opening and people worth meeting.
whoWeAre.bioGiacomo: Certified sommelier, raised in a family deeply rooted in wine culture. Spent a year in Bordeaux, visiting some of the most prestigious châteaux in the world. His passion was born at home, among the Langa vineyards. Currently studying at ESCP.
whoWeAre.bioFilippo: Spent a year in Bordeaux, gaining hands-on experience in the wine world. Deeply connected to his home region through Franciacorta, one of Italy's finest sparkling wine territories. Currently studying at ESCP.
whoWeAre.bioCristiano: A true Tuscan wine enthusiast, with a deep passion for the great wines of his region, from Chianti to Montalcino and Bolgheri. Currently studying at ESCP.
whoWeAre.bioRiccardo: A passionate lover of Piedmontese wines. The most recent addition to the team, but already a key contributor with a special impact. Currently studying at ESCP.
whoWeAre.heroTitle: Wine, told to a new generation.
whoWeAre.heroSubtitle: VIVO is a community born in Paris that brings young people closer to wine and helps wineries speak to tomorrow's consumers.
whoWeAre.timeline1Detail: A group of international students and young professionals, mostly from ESCP, sharing a real passion for wine. First evening, first sell-out.
whoWeAre.timeline2Detail: Turin, Parma, Versilia, Lake Garda and more. Every stop a new evening, every evening a bigger community.
whoWeAre.timeline3Detail: Visits to Europe's greatest estates, across Bordeaux, Champagne, the Langhe, Bolgheri, Franciacorta and Valpolicella.
whoWeAre.timeline4Detail: Our goal: to change the way the new generation sees wine.
whoWeAre.missionQuote: Sharing the real pleasure of wine, together, through a new kind of style.
whoWeAre.missionBody: We organise winery visits, wine parties and intimate tastings across Europe — open to everyone who loves wine, no matter their level.
whoWeAre.ctaText: Join a European community of young wine lovers.
whoWeAre.whatWeDoProblem: Wine consumption is declining, and the way a new generation relates to wine is changing faster than the industry can keep up.
whoWeAre.pillar1Body: Wine parties, evenings and private visits to great wineries. The real pleasure of wine, shared, with a new kind of style.
whoWeAre.pillar2Body: Content, communication and social strategy for wineries that want to genuinely speak to tomorrow's generation.

eventsHub.estatesIntro: The estates we've visited and partner with: the real access that makes every Winery Visit possible.

wineParty.conceptBody: A Wine Party is not just an event — it's a vibe. We bring together great bottles, a carefully curated DJ set and a crowd that actually cares about what's in their glass. No dress codes, no pretension. Just good wine, good music and good people.

wineryVisits.heroTagline: Behind the bottle, behind the vines.
wineryVisits.conceptBody: There is no better way to understand a wine than to stand in the vineyard where it was born. We organise private visits to iconic estates — cellars, barrel rooms, and guided tastings with the people who make the wine. Small groups, real access, no tourist traps.

wineLounge.heroTagline: The perfect evening, in the finest bars.
wineLounge.conceptBody: The Wine Lounge is our take on the perfect evening out — a handpicked wine bar, a small group of people who love wine, and a few hours to explore a list together. We scout the most interesting venues across Europe, so all you have to do is show up and taste.

statement.line: Wine does not have a quality problem. It has a storytelling problem.

footer.tagline: Wine, told to a new generation.

brands.statement: Wineries talk to people who already drink. We talk to the ones who have not started.
brands.intro1: Wine consumption is falling, and the generation that should take over does not recognise itself in the way wine is talked about. That is not a product problem. It is a voice problem.
brands.intro2: Vivo Studio is the bridge between wineries and the creators that generation actually follows. We do not make the commercial, the catalogue or the corporate post: we put your bottle in the hands of someone who tells it in their own words, to an audience that listens because it trusts them.
brands.step1Body: We work out what you want, who you want to reach, and what you are not willing to distort.
brands.step2Body: We pick profiles project by project, on tone and audience rather than follower count.
brands.step3Body: We run the shoot, at the estate or at an event, and the edit, keeping the creator’s voice intact.
brands.step4Body: The work goes out on the creators’ channels and on ours, and we look at what happens next.
brands.packagesNote: Every project is different, so we do not publish rate cards. These are the three shapes we start from.
brands.pack1Body: One creator, one project. The simplest way to hear how your estate sounds in a language that is not your own.
brands.pack1Meta: [Format, duration and deliverables to be defined]
brands.pack2Body: Several creators around a launch, a vintage or an event, with one thread and different voices.
brands.pack2Meta: [Number of creators and duration to be defined]
brands.pack3Body: A continuous presence: content through the year, a place at our events, access to the community.
brands.casesNote: The events are our case study: that is where you find out whether people actually show up.
brands.talentsBody: Profiles from 30,000 to 150,000 followers, chosen one by one.
brands.formBody: Tell us in two lines what you have in mind. We answer within a few days.
brands.partnersTitle: They have already worked with us
brands.partnersBody: Estates and venues that opened their doors to us for events and visits. They are not media clients: they are the reason we know how to get inside a winery.

talents.statement: Creators do not have an audience. They have an audience that trusts them.
talents.intro: Profiles from 30,000 to 150,000 followers, picked one by one on tone and audience rather than numbers. The network grows with every evening: people who talk about wine well end up drinking with us sooner or later.
talents.rosterEmpty: The roster is taking shape. If you make wine content, apply: we are choosing right now.
talents.applyBody: Two ways in: become an Ambassador and bring Vivo to your city, or join as a creator and work with the estates.
talents.brandsBody: We pick the profiles project by project, based on what you want to say.

manifesto.statement: We do not want to teach you wine. We want to drink it with you.
manifesto.body1: Vivo started in Paris in January 2026, among students and young professionals with one thing in common: they liked wine, but not the way it was being talked about. Too many rules, too much liturgy, too many people ready to make you feel wrong about a pairing.
manifesto.body2: The evenings came from there, then the winery visits, then the trips through Bordeaux, Champagne, the Langhe and Bolgheri. And a small army of young people who now order wine, choose it, and talk about it.
manifesto.ctaBody: The evenings fill up fast and the places are counted.
